Taylor Swift Apparently Committed The Ultimate Modern Marriage Sin

September 23, 2026

Clare Ath, Daily Wire, September 23, 2026

Share

A viral clip circulating social media right now arguably says more about American marriage than most think pieces will this year. In it is Taylor Swift, beaming, pointing to her wedding ring mouthing “that’s my husband” as she cheers for Travis Kelce during the Chiefs vs. Colts game. 

The commentary poured in immediately. While some found the moment sweet and supportive, others called it “cringe,” “performative,” and “fake.” That split is a story worth talking about — because somewhere in the last 30 years, our culture trained women to believe that devotion and public admiration of a husband is naive. The smart move, the relatable move, is to joke about his incompetence and to position yourself as better than him.
